name: Uncle Albert's Mysterious Island
summary: Uncle Albert's Mysterious Island is the third installment of the series around the fictional character Uncle Albert. It is aimed at players aged eight and above and, again, comes with a series of puzzles that can be completed in a non-linear order. To disclose the secrets of a lost and mysterious island, which globetrotter Uncle Albert discovered during his journeys in the middle of the ocean, the player has to make friends with the island's keeper Ernesto and to solve several puzzles by diving deep into stories and legends about the island's natives and pirates.
